title: Vault of Records
purpose: Preservation sector card and long-term-custody surfaces.
story: Rows of archival shelving receding into shadow — the deep memory of an institution, ordered, sealed, and enduring.
environment: A vast records vault, mobile shelving ranges marching away into darkness, a single aisle lit from above.
architecture: Industrial archive interior — a high concrete vault, ranked rolling stacks, a service gantry lost in the gloom above.
composition: Shelving ranges converging hard toward a distant vanishing point, one aisle light catching the nearest boxes, depth swallowed by negative space.
negativeExtra: any labels or writing on boxes or shelves
continuityNotes: Matches the set's near-black grade, single warm source, and brass-on-black accents of scene-01; all boxes remain unmarked.
